mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) by more than 0.25% within the last month signals a loosening of monetary policy, which typically leads to increased liquidity in the market and thus positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns of the S&P 500 are negative in more than 40% of the instances where the trigger condition is met.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) by more than 0.5% within the last month signals a weakening labor market, which typically leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as investors anticipate reduced consumer spending and economic slowdown.
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns of the S&P 500 are positive in more than 60% of the instances where the trigger condition is met.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in housing starts (HOUST) over the last two months indicates a strengthening demand in the housing market, which is a leading indicator of economic growth and thus positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 60-day forward returns of the S&P 500 are negative in more than 50% of the periods with sustained increases in housing starts.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in industrial production (INDPRO) by more than 1% over the last two months signals a contraction in supply, which can lead to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as investors anticipate reduced corporate earnings and economic output.
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns of the S&P 500 are positive in more than 60% of the instances where the trigger condition is met.

mechanism_narrative: When real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) increase by more than 1% and the unemployment rate (UNRATE) decreases by more than 0.2% over the last two months, it signals a strengthening consumer demand and labor market, which typically leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: RSAFS increases > 1% and UNRATE decreases > 0.2% in 2 months
failure_condition: If the 60-day forward returns of the S&P 500 are negative in more than 40% of the instances where the trigger condition is met.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) is above 2% and the Consumer Price Index (CPIAUCSL) increases by more than 0.5% over the last month, it signals an inflationary pressure in a tightening monetary environment, which typically leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: FEDFUNDS > 2% and CPIAUCSL increases > 0.5% in 1 month
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns of the S&P 500 are positive in more than 60% of the instances where the trigger condition is met.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) over the last three months indicates a strengthening labor market, which is a leading indicator of economic growth and thus positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 60-day forward returns of the S&P 500 are negative in more than 50% of the periods with sustained increases in nonfarm payrolls.

mechanism_narrative: When the GDP (GDPC1) grows by more than 2% year-over-year and the Consumer Price Index (CPIAUCSL) remains stable (increase < 0.3% over the last month), it signals strong economic growth without significant inflationary pressure, which typically leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: GDPC1 YoY growth > 2% and CPIAUCSL increases < 0.3% in 1 month
failure_condition: If the 60-day forward returns of the S&P 500 are negative in more than 40% of the instances where the trigger condition is met.
